opinions.point: Many viewers enjoyed the RPG mechanics, loot systems, dungeon action, and strategic combat.
Ruche was repeatedly praised as entertaining, expressive, and a standout character, with strong voice acting.
Several commenters felt the second cour or recent episodes showed improved pacing and less intrusive recap.
Some viewers found the episode fun and engaging but still noticed repeated scenes, exposition, and padding.
A substantial group criticized the recurring recap-heavy structure and considered the pacing frustrating or inconsistent.
Some viewers disliked the visual presentation, including filters, camera movement, and animation quality.

notes: The thread title and post body clearly identify the exact show and Episode 14; the prior episode discussion also confirms this is the second cour beginning October 1.
